moments.title: Premier League Sunday Showdowns
moments.blurb: Today features a packed Premier League schedule with four major fixtures including Leeds vs Man Utd and Nottingham Forest vs Arsenal.

angles.name: Matchday Buzz
angles.copy: Premier League Sunday is ON! Who are you backing today? Massive clashes like Leeds vs Man Utd and Forest vs Arsenal. #PremierLeague

angles.name: Local Rivalry Focus
angles.copy: It's a huge one for Leeds fans today as they face rivals Manchester United in the Premier League. Get ready for fireworks! #LUFC #MUFC

moments.title: Champions League Returns
moments.blurb: Midweek sees Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League, with UK giants Manchester City, Liverpool, Manchester United, Arsenal, and Aston Villa all in action on Tuesday and Wednesday.

angles.name: UK Clubs in Europe
angles.copy: Champions League is back! Man City, Liverpool, Man Utd, Arsenal & Aston Villa all flying the flag. Who's picking up crucial points this week?

angles.name: Big Tuesday/Wednesday Games
angles.copy: Huge European nights ahead! Man City face AEK Athens and Liverpool play Villarreal on Tuesday, then Man Utd, Arsenal, and Aston Villa are in action Wednesday. Predict the scores!

moments.title: Europa League Midweek
moments.blurb: Europa League Matchday 3 takes place on Thursday, with English clubs Sunderland, Crystal Palace, and Bournemouth, and Scottish side Celtic, all competing.

angles.name: Europa League Thursday
angles.copy: Thursday night lights! Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Bournemouth, and Celtic are all battling it out in the Europa League. Who are you rooting for?

angles.name: Celtic in Europe
angles.copy: Celtic are in Europa League action this Thursday! Can they secure a vital win on Matchday 3?

moments.title: RAYE at Royal Albert Hall
moments.blurb: Grammy-nominated superstar RAYE performs a special symphonic reimagining of her chart-topping album 'THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE.' at London's Royal Albert Hall on Friday, October 23rd.

angles.name: Symphonic RAYE
angles.copy: RAYE's taking over the Royal Albert Hall this Friday for a truly special symphonic show! Expect an incredible night of 'THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE.'.

angles.name: London Gig Alert
angles.copy: London! RAYE at the Royal Albert Hall this Friday is going to be epic. Who's got tickets to this one-off symphonic experience?

moments.title: J. Cole's 'The Fall-Off Tour' Hits The O2
moments.blurb: US rapper J. Cole brings his highly anticipated 'The Fall-Off Tour' to London's O2 Arena for two nights on October 19th and 20th, before returning in November.

angles.name: J. Cole London Dates
angles.copy: J. Cole is at The O2 in London tonight and tomorrow! Who's ready for 'The Fall-Off Tour'?

angles.name: Rap Royalty in UK
angles.copy: London's buzzing as J. Cole lands for his O2 shows! His first solo headline tour in five years – it's going to be massive.

moments.title: Duran Duran UK Arena Tour
moments.blurb: Duran Duran continue their UK arena tour this week, with dates including Birmingham (Oct 20), Liverpool (Oct 23), Leeds (Oct 24), and a special Halloween show at London's O2 (Oct 31).

angles.name: Duran Duran Live
angles.copy: Duran Duran are still touring the UK this week! Catch them in Birmingham, Liverpool, and Leeds before their big Halloween O2 show.

angles.name: Halloween Special
angles.copy: Get ready for a 'Danse Macabre' with Duran Duran! Their special Halloween show at London's O2 on Oct 31st promises twisted hits and unexpected deep cuts. Costumes encouraged!

moments.title: Taylor Swift Holds UK No.1
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' remains at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending October 22nd, marking another week at number one for the global superstar.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Queen of the charts! Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' is still your UK Number 1 single. Can anyone knock her off next week?

angles.name: Still No.1
angles.copy: Another week, another number one for Taylor Swift! 'Patient Zero' continues its reign at the top of the UK singles chart.

moments.title: Tinie Tempah Drops New Album
moments.blurb: Tinie Tempah's ambitious new album 'The Night's Not Dead' was released yesterday, October 16th, tracing a single night out across three EPs converging into the full project.

angles.name: New Music Friday Follow-Up
angles.copy: Did you check out Tinie Tempah's new album 'The Night's Not Dead' yet? It's a journey through a single night out, from start to finish.

angles.name: Album Concept
angles.copy: Tinie Tempah's 'The Night's Not Dead' is out now! An ambitious concept album tracing a night out – what are your favourite tracks so far?

moments.title: My Chemical Romance 'Black Parade' at 20
moments.blurb: My Chemical Romance's iconic album 'The Black Parade' is set to receive a 20th-anniversary edition release on October 23rd, celebrating two decades since its original debut.

angles.name: MCR Anniversary
angles.copy: Can you believe 'The Black Parade' is 20?! My Chemical Romance are re-releasing their iconic album this Friday. What a classic!

angles.name: Eyeliner & Nostalgia
angles.copy: Get ready to feel old! My Chemical Romance's 'The Black Parade' turns 20 this week with a special anniversary edition. Time to dig out the black eyeliner.

moments.title: Michael Eavis Turns 91
moments.blurb: Michael Eavis, the legendary founder and organiser of the Glastonbury Festival, celebrates his 91st birthday today, October 18th.

angles.name: Glastonbury Legend
angles.copy: Happy 91st Birthday to the man who started it all, Michael Eavis! Forever grateful for Glastonbury. What's your favourite Glasto memory?

angles.name: Festival Icon
angles.copy: Raise a cider to Michael Eavis, who turns 91 today! The visionary behind Glastonbury Festival. Here's to many more years of mud and music (for us, not him!).

moments.title: Mark King of Level 42 Turns 68
moments.blurb: Mark King, the iconic bassist and lead vocalist of the British jazz-funk band Level 42, celebrates his 68th birthday on October 20th.

angles.name: Level 42 Legend
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the incredible Mark King of Level 42! The man who put the slap in pop. What's your favourite Level 42 track?

angles.name: Bass Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 68th Birthday to Level 42's Mark King! His bass playing is legendary. What song makes you want to groove?

moments.title: Shaggy Turns 58
moments.blurb: Jamaican-American reggae star Shaggy, known for global hits like 'It Wasn't Me' and 'Boombastic', celebrates his 58th birthday on October 22nd.

angles.name: It Wasn't Me!
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the one and only Shaggy! Get ready to 'Boombastic' your day. What's your favourite Shaggy hit?

angles.name: Reggae Star
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to reggae icon Shaggy! Turning 58 on Thursday. Time to turn up the volume!

moments.title: 'Weird Al' Yankovic Turns 67
moments.blurb: The undisputed king of musical parody, 'Weird Al' Yankovic, celebrates his 67th birthday on October 23rd.

angles.name: Parody King
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the legendary 'Weird Al' Yankovic! What's your favourite parody song he's ever done?

angles.name: Accordion Ace
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the one and only 'Weird Al' Yankovic! Still making us laugh at 67. Which of his hits gets stuck in your head?

moments.title: RAYE Celebrates 29th Birthday
moments.blurb: Chart-topping British singer-songwriter RAYE, fresh from her Royal Albert Hall show, celebrates her 29th birthday on October 24th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday RAYE
angles.copy: From Number 1s to incredible live shows, Happy 29th Birthday to the phenomenal RAYE! We're celebrating all her hits today.

angles.name: British Talent
angles.copy: A huge Happy 29th Birthday to our very own RAYE! What's your go-to track from her incredible catalogue?

moments.title: Bill Wyman Turns 90
moments.blurb: Former Rolling Stones bassist Bill Wyman, who played with the legendary band for over three decades, celebrates his 90th birthday on October 24th.

angles.name: Stones Legend
angles.copy: Happy 90th Birthday to the legendary Bill Wyman, former bassist of The Rolling Stones! What an incredible career. What's your favourite Stones track?

angles.name: Rock & Roll Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating 90 years of rock and roll with Bill Wyman today! Wishing the former Rolling Stones legend a very Happy Birthday.

moments.title: Katy Perry Turns 42
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Katy Perry, known for chart-topping hits like 'Firework' and 'Roar', celebrates her 42nd birthday on October 25th.

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: Happy 42nd Birthday to the incredible Katy Perry! From 'I Kissed a Girl' to 'Roar', she's given us so many anthems. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Birthday Anthems
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 42nd Birthday to Katy Perry! Time to blast her biggest hits all day long. What's on your playlist?

moments.title: British Summer Time Ends
moments.blurb: British Summer Time officially comes to an end on Sunday, October 25th, as clocks go back an hour, marking the return to Greenwich Mean Time.

angles.name: Clocks Go Back
angles.copy: Don't forget! British Summer Time ends this Sunday, October 25th. Clocks go back one hour, meaning an extra hour in bed! #GMT

angles.name: Darker Evenings
angles.copy: The nights draw in this Sunday as BST ends. Are you looking forward to cosy evenings, or missing the longer daylight already?

moments.title: Halloween in the City
moments.blurb: Manchester's 'Halloween in the City' festival kicks off on October 24th, bringing spooky monsters, live performances, and fancy-dress fun to the city until October 31st.

angles.name: Manchester Spooky Fun
angles.copy: Manchester gets spooky this Friday! 'Halloween in the City' brings monsters, performances & fancy dress. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Family Frights
angles.copy: Get ready for some family-friendly frights! Manchester's Halloween festival starts this Friday, running all the way to October 31st.

moments.title: Scottish International Storytelling Festival
moments.blurb: The Scottish International Storytelling Festival begins on October 21st, offering live oral storytelling, music, workshops, and family events across Edinburgh and Scotland until October 31st.

angles.name: Stories from Scotland
angles.copy: Dive into tales from around the world! The Scottish International Storytelling Festival kicks off this Wednesday, bringing live stories and music to Edinburgh and beyond.

angles.name: Culture in Scotland
angles.copy: Looking for something different? The Scottish International Storytelling Festival starts this week, celebrating oral traditions across Scotland. Perfect for all ages!

moments.title: October Half Term Approaches
moments.blurb: Schools across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland break up for their October Half Term holidays starting Monday, October 26th.

angles.name: Half Term Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown to October Half Term is on! Schools in England, Wales, and NI break up next Monday. What are your plans?

angles.name: Welsh Half Term
angles.copy: Planning your family fun for next week? October Half Term starts Monday for schools across Wales! We've got ideas coming your way.
